description: The Heavenly Sword, best known as Ame-no-Murakumo-no-Tsurugi (“Sword of the Gathering Clouds of Heaven”) and later Kusanagi-no-Tsurugi, is one of the most famous sacred weapons of early Japanese mythology. According to traditions recorded centuries after the Yayoi and Yamatai periods, the storm god Susanoo discovered the sword inside the serpent Yamata-no-Orochi and presented it to the sun goddess Amaterasu; it later became associated with heroic princes and imperial legitimacy. Together with the mirror and jewel, the sword formed part of the Imperial Regalia of Japan, symbolizing divine authority and martial power.
